summary: Frontend-only validation of 3 features (AI IOC summary, Save-to-IOC-DB with admin gating, Admin lead assignee/notes/status-filter). All flows pass end-to-end. Seeded a lead and used 91.219.236.10 as the pre-existing IOC (review requested 185.220.101.4 but that value is NOT in Mongo; only 91.219.236.10 and the just-saved 45.9.148.99 were present).
action_items: None functional. Optional: the review's assumption that 185.220.101.4 exists in the IOC DB is incorrect; consider adding a seed script (or update playbook) so a well-known malicious IP is always present for demos.
Minor: a single 404 (resource) is logged in console during admin flow (likely a missing static asset/favicon). Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: IocAnalyzer.jsx uses `isAdmin = !!user` which is fine since only admins log in, but semantically prefer `user?.role === 'admin'` for future multi-role safety.
In Admin.jsx `updateLeadField` optimistically updates local state before PATCH; on failure it toasts but does NOT roll back. Consider reverting on error so UI matches DB.
Assignee/Notes inputs use `defaultValue` — correct choice for uncontrolled blur-save pattern, but if the leads list is refetched while typing, the field will not update. Acceptable for current UX.
seed_data_creation: POST /api/leads created one TEST_ lead (test@example.com / TestCorp) to enable lead management UI testing. Saved IOC 45.9.148.99 via analyzer as part of the flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Guest AI summary works (~5s response). Admin save+badge flow works. Known-IOC detection works when the DB actually contains the IP — use 91.219.236.10 (or the freshly-saved 45.9.148.99). Two leads now exist in DB (TEST Lead + Test User); their status was set to 'contacted' during regression testing.

ADMIN /threat-intelligence: analyze 45.9.148.99 -> ioc-save-btn visible, click saves and swaps to ioc-saved-badge; row appears in IOC Database table

ADMIN /admin -> Leads tab: lead-status-filter present; typing lead-assignee-0 and lead-notes-0 blurs to PATCH /leads/{id} and persists across full page reload
Status filter (archived/new) narrows visible rows correctly
